1. sourceFidelity - 2: The general layout of the stadium and advertising boards is recognizable, but extreme stylization obscures most specific details.
2. temporalConsistency - 4: The visual noise and dot patterns remain highly stable between the two frames with no noticeable flickering or morphing.
3. identityConsistency - 1: Players are reduced to indistinct, unrecognizable blobs of black and white pixels.
4. motionFidelity - 1: It is impossible to discern any player movement or ball trajectory due to the loss of detail.
5. sceneFidelity - 2: The background structure (stands, ads) is present but heavily distorted by the halftone effect.
6. stylizationStrength - 5: The transformation into a high-contrast, dithered ink-manga style is extremely aggressive and obvious.
